snippet.title: Shooty Seas Game Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Shooty Seas is an action based shootem up, smashem up Pirate exploration game.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bonedstudios.android.shootyseas

You take on the role of a pirate exploring and plundering the seas. Your mayhem is sure to attract the attention of the locals. Fight them off using such standard pirate weapons as cannons, harpoons, flying skulls, machine guns, long range missiles, hammers forged from collapsing stars, flamethrowers, and more. Defeat area bosses to find treasure chest. Collect items, equip your ship, buy new ships, better ships, faster ships, cooler ships that can summon ghost ships to come fight along side with you. But too much mayhem brings on the Royal Navy, or the Reef Pirates, or worse, much... much worse.
